output.summary: A grass native to the Old World tropics, Eragrostis ciliaris has also been introduced across tropical and subtropical parts of the Americas and some Pacific islands. Its small, nutritious seeds are edible but difficult to harvest and handle, so they are usually regarded as famine food.
